title: SUBJECT:
summary: A March 19, 1975 White House memorandum of conversation on the 'Matador' meeting in the Cabinet Room. Participants: President Ford, Schlesinger, Buchen, Marsh, Rumsfeld, Scowcroft, and Colby. They discuss a successful, secret operation (likely the Soviet submarine recovery), whether to confirm it publicly, and Soviet reaction. Marked SECRET/NODIS/XGDS and declassified.

title: VOLUME .
summary: Archival folder metadata from the National Security Adviser Memoranda of Conversations collection (Box 10): folder titled 'March 19, 1975 - Ford, Schlesinger, Colby, Buchen, Marsh, Rumsfeld'. Includes collection/series ID 031400426, volume, and withdrawal record dated 05/28/2004 by archivist 'GG'. No substantive conversation content is shown.
